sourceSentences: [0] himer Dinger is a very Hit or Miss Champion his design makes him weak against any Champion that outranges him and his turrets but incredibly obnoxious for any melee Champion
[0] on top of that he is reliant on hitting his e as it almost guarantees a full combo notably his W and his turret lasers
[0] this ability is a projectile so the travel time is long the farther he throws it this makes it easier to dodge from far away
[0] that's why I recommend paying close attention to a z animation and use your dash or your flash reactively
[0] he hits he fully charging his turrets they throw their laser beams he then lands W and his second wave of laser beams are shot at you
[1] The only thing you want to take is something to outrange him. There's a lot of ADCs that can outrange him such as Ezreal, Jhin, whatever you want.
[1] But the important thing when it comes to mages is in my opinion at least to get out of the lane. And once you get out of the lane it kind of like feels so all really flat.
